# Country scope. Any human East Slavic country eligible for Playable Rus' Phase 2 (1480-1600).

    is_ai = no
    is_rebel_country = no
    oe_rus_country = yes
}

# Any scope. Live human Rus' player tracked in global_var:oe_rp2_player.
oe_rp2_has_live_player = {
    has_global_variable = oe_rp2_player
    country_exists = global_var:oe_rp2_player
}

# Country scope. Yoke broken via Phase 1 flag, IO dissolved, non-member, or post-1480 era.
oe_rp2_yoke_clear = {
	exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
    OR = {
        oe_rpl_yoke_is_broken = yes
        NOT = { exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
        NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke }
        current_year >= 1480
    }
}

# Any scope. Byzantium / restored Rome 3-state live status for Sophia Palaiologina marriage & Third Rome hooks.
oe_rp2_byz_holds_city = {
    location:constantinople = {
        exists = owner
        OR = {
            AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ owner = c:BYZ }
            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM owner = c:ROM }
        }
    }
}

oe_rp2_byz_in_exile = {
    OR = {
        country_exists = c:BYZ
        country_exists = c:ROM
    }
    NOT = { oe_rp2_byz_holds_city = yes }
}

oe_rp2_byz_fallen = {
    NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { country_exists = c:ROM }
}

            NOT = { oe_rpl_has_path = yes }

}
